body.name: Global minimax criteria
body.construction: \(R^{\star}=\inf_{\widetilde\theta}\sup_{x\in\mathcal M_{T,m}}\mathbb E_x[(\widetilde\theta-\ell(x))^2],\quad \operatorname{EL}^{\star}_{\alpha}=\inf_{C:\inf_{x\in\mathcal M_{T,m}}\Pr_x\{\ell(x)\in C(Z)\}\ge1-\alpha}\sup_{x\in\mathcal M_{T,m}}\mathbb E_x[\operatorname{length}C(Z)]\)
